Title: Free items toggle and Price range mutual exclusivity + Price sort hiding
Preconditions: User opens the Search Filters panel.
Steps:
1. Select Sort 'Price low→high' and enter Price range 50 to 200.
2. Toggle 'Free items only' ON.
3. Enter 10 in Price min while 'Free items only' is ON.
Expected Result: Turning 'Free items only' ON clears Price range, hides 'Price low→high' and 'Price high→low' sort options, and resets active sort to 'Best match'. Entering 10 in Price min turns 'Free items only' OFF.

Title: Price min > max auto-swap on blur and empty bound handling
Preconditions: User opens the Search Filters panel.
Steps:
1. Enter Min = 200 and Max = 50, then blur/leave the field.
2. Clear Min (empty) and leave Max = 200, then apply filters.
Expected Result: On blur, Min and Max automatically swap to Min = 50 and Max = 200. Empty Min defaults to 0 (results priced 0–200).

Title: Location permission toggling dynamically enables/disables Distance and Nearest sort without reopening panel
Preconditions: Location permission is denied; user opens the Search Filters panel.
Steps:
1. Select 'Meetup' deal method and inspect Distance and 'Nearest' sort.
2. Grant location permission in browser/OS settings while keeping the filter panel open.
Expected Result: While permission is denied, Distance and 'Nearest' sort are disabled with helper text 'Turn on location to use this'. Immediately upon granting permission, both become enabled without closing/reopening the panel.

Title: Bidirectional coupling between Meetup deal method, Distance radius, and Nearest sort
Preconditions: Location permission is granted; filter panel is at defaults.
Steps:
1. Verify Distance is disabled when Meetup is unselected.
2. Select Sort = 'Nearest'.
3. Set Distance = '5 km'.
4. Deselect 'Meetup'.
Expected Result: Selecting 'Nearest' automatically checks 'Meetup' and enables Distance. Deselecting 'Meetup' resets Distance to 'Any', disables Distance, and reverts Sort from 'Nearest' back to 'Best match'.

Title: no_condition categories hide and permanently clear selected Condition filters
Preconditions: User opens the Search Filters panel.
Steps:
1. Select Category = 'Electronics' and Condition = 'Brand new', 'Like new'.
2. Change Category to 'Services' (flagged no_condition).
3. Change Category back to 'Electronics'.
Expected Result: Selecting 'Services' hides the Condition filter and clears the selections; switching back to 'Electronics' shows Condition again with no conditions selected.

Title: Live result count updates, removable filter chips apply interaction rules, and Reset restores defaults
Preconditions: Location permission is granted; user applies Meetup, Distance 10 km, Nearest sort, and Condition 'Like new'.
Steps:
1. Observe 'Show N results' button count as each filter changes.
2. Click 'Show N results' and verify applied filter chips above results.
3. Remove the 'Meetup' chip directly from the results header.
4. Reopen filter panel and tap 'Reset'.
Expected Result: 'Show N results' updates live; removing the 'Meetup' chip also removes '10 km' Distance and resets Sort to 'Best match'; 'Reset' returns all filters to default state.
